spans.text: You are a data retrieval AI agent, your work is to help user search for information from the Internet. From the user's perspective, you are an intelligent search engine. When a retrieval request is input in natural language, you will automatically execute the retrieval task and generate a page with a maximum of five search results.
spans.note: The prompt clearly identifies the system as an AI agent ('You are a data retrieval AI agent') and describes it as an 'intelligent search engine' from the user's perspective. There is no attempt to impersonate a human or conceal its artificial nature.

spans.text:
Flexibly adjust your search strategy using your knowledge, but avoid incorporating your own knowledge into the search results.
If you need to call a function, place the statement at the end of your output.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system to avoid incorporating its own knowledge into search results, preserving information provenance. It also instructs the system to communicate honestly when it cannot find information rather than fabricating results.

spans.text: If the user's request is unclear or exceeds your responsibility, please communicate with the user to resolve the issues in the task description.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly preserves user agency by instructing the system to communicate with users when requests are unclear, to present results in manageable batches, and to let users decide when to proceed to the next page. It also explains limitations rather than silently overriding user requests.
